source_claim: The official TV anime site for The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 1 identifies Iwatani Naofumi (岩谷尚文) and Raphtalia (ラフタリア) in its introduction/episode synopses and profiles, and names Melty (メルティ) in episode 9 and later synopses. notes: The official site explicitly names these three current campaign characters. No campaign aliases, surnames, or other unlisted identities are inferred.
